div.div:
القُبِّيُّونَ , [in the CK القُبِيُّونَ,] occurring in a trad., in the saying خَيْرُ النَّاسِ القُبِّيُّونَ, means, (Th, O, K,) if the trad. be correct, (Th, O,) Those who continue uninterruptedly fasting [except in the night] until their bellies become lank: (Th, O, K:)
or, accord. to one relation, it is ↓ المُقَبَّبُونَ , which means the same. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
